title: Owed Minimum Under Open Disputes and Recent Return Credits — Ridgeline Consumer Credit
content:
**Clause.** On a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account the unpaid minimum is the owed minimum less the payments credited in the last month, never below zero. The owed minimum on a revolving card (a tier with a minimum-payment percentage above zero) is recomputed when a billing dispute on the account is still open (submitted and not yet decided): the minimum-payment formula is applied to the latest statement balance less the open disputed amounts, giving the greater of the tier's minimum payment floor (or that reduced balance itself when it is smaller) and the tier's minimum-payment percentage of that reduced balance rounded to the nearest cent, plus the latest statement's past-due amount. With no open dispute but return credits posted in the last month (dated less than 1 full month before today), it is recomputed the same way on the latest statement balance less those credits. Otherwise the owed minimum is the latest statement's minimum payment due.

| Account and records | Balance the formula is applied to | Owed minimum |
|---|---|---|
| revolving card, a billing dispute still open | latest statement balance less the open disputed amounts | recomputed, plus the past-due amount |
| revolving card, no open dispute, return credits in the last month | latest statement balance less those credits | recomputed, plus the past-due amount |
| any other case, every Ridgeline Project Loan included | — | the latest statement's minimum payment due as printed |

The open disputed amounts are the disputed amounts of the account's billing dispute requests whose status is submitted. The tier's floor and percentage are those of the minimum payment terms table.

## Worked owed minimums (hypothetical Card Preferred: 3.0 percent, floor 35.00; latest statement balance 2000.00, past-due 35.00, printed minimum 95.00)

| Records | Reduced balance | Formula result | Owed minimum |
|---|---|---|---|
| open dispute of 500.00 | 1500.00 | 3.0 percent is 45.00, above 35.00 | 80.00 |
| no dispute, return credits of 1800.00 in the last month | 200.00 | 3.0 percent is 6.00; the floor 35.00 is greater | 70.00 |
| no dispute, return credits of 1980.00 in the last month | 20.00 | the reduced balance 20.00 is below the floor and stands in its place; 3.0 percent is 0.60 | 55.00 |
| no dispute, no return credit in the last month | — | — | 95.00 |
